# prilojject/runpod-llama-factory

> Runpod Serverless worker for headless LlamaFactory v0.9.5 fine-tuning. Input: an official LlamaFactory YAML (or form fields) plus an alpaca/sharegpt dataset (dataset_url, dataset_inline, or a named dataset). Output: LoRA/QLoRA adapter (adapter_model.safetensors + adapter_config.json + tokenizer) on a network volume, Hugging Face repo, or S3/archive. Stages: SFT, DPO, ORPO and SimPO (stage=dpo + pref_loss), KTO. Methods: QLoRA 4/8-bit, 16-bit LoRA, freeze, full. Default: Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 @ cdbee75f17c01a7cc42f958dc650907174af0554, QLoRA 4-bit bnb, template qwen3_nothink, lora_rank 8, bf16, 24 GB GPU (RTX 4090). Weights are not baked in; cache on /runpod-volume/llama-factory/models. refresh_worker is true. CUDA: torch 2.7.1+cu128 (Blackwell sm_100/sm_120 kernels included), driver CUDA 12.8+ (allowedCudaVersions 12.8-13.4); only RTX 4090 measured. Gradio / LLaMA Board is never started (gradio is not installed). This is not runpod-unsloth-finetune (use_unsloth is always false).

Worker code is MIT. Upstream LlamaFactory (hiyouga/LlamaFactory) is Apache-2.0, pinned to tag v0.9.5 / SHA 7af909522a951e3ad9f022ea6f88b6755257eaa5 — not floating main. Default weights Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 are Apache-2.0 and not gated (~7.49 GiB). Other base models keep their own licenses. transformers==4.57.1 (inside the tag range; 4.57.0 is excluded). trust_remote_code defaults to false. Stages pt/rm/ppo are not exposed. Do not accept tokens in the job input or YAML.

## Docs

- README.md — what you send/get, defaults, licenses, implementation notes, FAQ
- AGENTS.md — constraints for automated changes
- openapi.yaml — job input / output schema
- NOTICE — MIT vs Apache-2.0 attribution
- examples/configs/ — sample LlamaFactory YAMLs
- examples/requests/ — dry-run, smoke, ORPO, fields, resume
- examples/datasets/ — bundled MIT tiny_sft / tiny_dpo / tiny_kto (not Stanford Alpaca)

## Default smoke-sized job

```json
{
  "input": {
    "dataset": "tiny_sft",
    "stage": "sft",
    "finetuning_type": "lora",
    "quantization_bit": 4,
    "max_steps": 5,
    "max_samples": 16,
    "cutoff_len": 512,
    "lora_rank": 8
  }
}
```
